summary: Feature request to add worker-level heartbeating configuration options to the PHP SDK, matching the Go SDK implementation. Users should be able to disable or configure heartbeating behavior and ensure accurate SDK metadata is recorded.
userImpact: PHP SDK users cannot configure or disable worker heartbeating behavior, limiting control over heartbeat settings and preventing accurate SDK metadata recording.
proposedFix: Pass through options similar to the Go SDK implementation to allow users to configure heartbeating behavior and ensure accurate SDK metadata recording.
keyQuote: Worker-level heartbeating is implemented in Go, we need to make sure users can disable it if desired via configuration.
